verdict.rationale: Orama has an AI answer engine (AnswerSession / Orama Cloud), so consuming external MCP tools is a plausible capability. However, the evidence documents only Orama acting as an MCP server, which exposes project data to clients like ChatGPT and Cursor. That is the server role and cannot be credited to this client-side story, and nothing shows Orama connecting to or using third-party MCP servers.
